name: Acute Ischemic / Coronary Red Flag
message: Potential red flag detected — acute crushing chest pain with radiation and diaphoresis. Immediate clinical assessment recommended.
clinical_rationale: Symptoms suggest possible Acute Coronary Syndrome (ACS) or acute cardiac event requiring urgent ECG and clinical evaluation.

name: Acute Respiratory Distress Red Flag
message: Potential red flag detected — acute severe respiratory compromise. Immediate clinical assessment recommended.
clinical_rationale: High risk of acute pulmonary embolism, severe asthma/COPD exacerbation, or pneumothorax.

name: Acute Neurological / Stroke Red Flag
message: Potential red flag detected — sudden onset focal neurological deficit. Immediate clinical assessment recommended.
clinical_rationale: Suspicion of acute cerebrovascular event (Stroke) requiring immediate FAST assessment and stroke protocol activation.

name: Acute Anaphylaxis / Severe Allergic Reaction

chief_complaint_keywords: diffuse urticaria after injection or medication

message: Potential red flag detected — acute airway compromise or systemic allergic reaction. Immediate clinical assessment recommended.
clinical_rationale: Possible anaphylactic shock requiring immediate IM epinephrine and airway management.
